rows.label: Baba Yaga
rows.hook: lives in a hut that stands on chicken legs and flies through the forest in a giant mortar and pestle

rows.label: Anubis
rows.description: Egyptian deity of mummification and the afterlife, usually depicted as a man with a canine head
rows.hook: guides the dead through the afterlife and is shown with a jackal's head

rows.label: Yggdrasil
rows.description: immense mythical tree in Norse cosmology, connecting the Nine Worlds
rows.hook: connects nine worlds as the great tree at the center of the cosmos, with a serpent gnawing at its roots

rows.label: banshee
rows.description: female spirit of death in Irish mythology
rows.hook: wails outside a house to warn that someone inside is about to die

rows.label: Cerberus
rows.description: three-headed dog that guards the underworld in Greek mythology
rows.hook: guards the gates of the underworld with three snarling heads so nothing can escape

rows.label: valkyrie
rows.description: one of a host of female figures who decide which soldiers die in battle and which live
rows.hook: chooses which warriors die in battle and carries the bravest fallen to a great hall in the sky

rows.label: griffin
rows.description: mythical creature with the body of a lion and head and wings of an eagle
rows.hook: has the body of a lion and the head and wings of an eagle, said to guard hidden treasure

rows.label: qilin
rows.hook: appears only in times of peace and prosperity, blending the features of a dragon, deer, and ox

rows.label: sphinx
rows.description: mythological creature with the head of a human and the body of a lion
rows.hook: poses a riddle to travelers and devours anyone who cannot answer it

rows.label: Sekhmet
rows.hook: breathes fire and plague upon enemies but can also heal the sick, shown with a lioness's head

rows.label: Jötnar
rows.description: race of beings in Germanic mythology
rows.hook: are giants who live apart from the gods and often clash with them in ancient tales

rows.label: Fenrir
rows.hook: is a monstrous wolf bound by a magic chain until he breaks free at the end of the world

rows.label: Pegasus
rows.hook: is a winged horse that sprang from a slain monster's blood and carries heroes through the sky

rows.label: kelpie
rows.hook: lurks in lochs as a water horse and drags unwary riders who climb on its back beneath the surface

rows.label: leprechaun
rows.hook: hides a pot of gold and must grant three wishes to anyone who catches him and holds on tight

rows.label: troll
rows.description: supernatural being in Norse mythology and Scandinavian folklore
rows.hook: lives under bridges or deep in the mountains and turns to stone if caught in sunlight

rows.label: Sobek
rows.hook: is shown with a crocodile's head and was honored to calm the dangers of the river

rows.label: Simurgh
rows.description: mythical bird in Iranian mythology and literature
rows.hook: is an ancient bird so old it has watched the world end and begin again three times over
